causal_boundary.finding: A saved Network replay intentionally reloads the selected page. The active-tab hook sets pageKey to null on top-frame navigation and later recomputes it from the new documentId. PatternsTab captures the pre-reload pageKey/runSeq in handleRun; its pageKey effect increments runSeq and clears rows, error, name and resultPageKey. Its isCurrent predicate then rejects the eventual success, error, progress and final refresh from this same replay. visibleRows additionally requires resultPageKey to equal the current pageKey. Thus the driver's Last run/current-row oracle cannot be satisfied by a normally observed owned reload, even if the capture core returns current rows. This is a product UI lifecycle mismatch supported by frozen source, with the native new-context trace as the reload positive control; the receipt does not expose the live React pageKey transition directly.

The receipt does not show whether the core accepted it, closed cleanly, returned rows to the worker, or sent a result/error over the saved-operation port.
